name: context-usage-monitor
displayName: Context and Usage Monitor for Claude Code
description: Status bar monitor for Claude Code: correct context-window %, cache hit rate, per-turn and monthly cost. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

configuration.title: Context and Usage Monitor for Claude Code

contextUsageMonitor.statusBar.priority.description: Status bar priority (higher = further left within its alignment).

contextUsageMonitor.statusBar.segments.description: Which segments to show in the status bar, in order. 'cacheHit' is off by default — add it here to show. Monthly cost has its own toggle: statusBar.showMonthlyCost.

contextUsageMonitor.statusBar.separator.description: Separator character between status bar segments (no need to add spaces — they're added automatically around it).

contextUsageMonitor.statusBar.colorMode.description: Background color policy for the status bar item. 'none' keeps the default theme background. 'rateLimit' warns/errors as your 5-hour or weekly subscription usage climbs.

contextUsageMonitor.statusBar.showEffort.description: Show the reasoning-effort level (low/medium/high) in parentheses after the model name, when Claude Code recorded one for the turn.

contextUsageMonitor.statusBar.showMonthl.description: Show total month-to-date usage cost in the status bar, appended at the end. Unlike the other segments, this renders even when idle — it's a background total, not tied to the current turn.

contextUsageMonitor.tooltip.sections.description: Which sections to show in the hover tooltip, in order.

contextUsageMonitor.pricing.models.description: Per-model pricing/context-window overrides, merged over the built-in defaults. Keys are model IDs (e.g. 'claude-opus-5'); values may set any of input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite5m, cacheWrite1h ($/token) and contextWindow (tokens).

contextUsageMonitor.pricing.currencySymb.description: Currency symbol used when formatting costs.

contextUsageMonitor.usage.billingCycleSt.description: Day of the month your billing cycle starts on (1-28). The monthly cost total covers from this day in the current or previous month through now.

contextUsageMonitor.filters.modelPattern.description: Regular expression a model id must match to be counted. Excludes non-Claude / synthetic records.

contextUsageMonitor.filters.includeSidec.description: Include subagent (sidechain) turns when computing the main context-window gauge. They are always included in cost totals.

contextUsageMonitor.contextWindowOverrid.description: Per-model context window overrides (tokens), keyed by model id. Shortcut for pricing.models.<id>.contextWindow.

contextUsageMonitor.rateLimits.enabled.description: Show 5-hour/weekly subscription rate-limit gauges (e.g. '5h:34% · w:53%') in the status bar. Makes a network request to api.anthropic.com using your existing local Claude Code OAuth token (the same one Claude Code itself uses) — only when you're on a subscription plan; never on API-key/Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry billing, where it's silently hidden. Refreshes the moment a new Claude Code turn is detected, plus a periodic backstop check (see scheduledCheckEnabled) — shared across all open VS Code windows via a local cache, so opening more windows never multiplies the request rate.

contextUsageMonitor.rateLimits.refreshSe.description: Minimum interval, in seconds, between network checks for the 5-hour/weekly rate-limit gauges — acts as both the scheduled backstop's interval and the floor below which the on-new-turn trigger won't re-fetch. Default is 15 minutes; raise it if you have many windows open and see rate-limit errors on the fetch itself.

contextUsageMonitor.rateLimits.scheduled.description: Also run a periodic backstop check every refreshSeconds, in addition to refreshing whenever a new Claude Code turn is detected. The on-turn trigger alone keeps the gauge accurate while you're actively working; this backstop exists only to catch a rate-limit window resetting during a long idle stretch with no activity. Disable it for zero idle-time network use, at the cost of a possibly stale gauge until your next turn.

contextUsageMonitor.rateLimits.showWeekl.description: Show the weekly ('w:') rate-limit gauge alongside the 5-hour one.

contextUsageMonitor.rateLimits.showPerMo.description: Show per-model weekly gauges (Opus/Sonnet) in the tooltip when your plan reports them (Max plans only; always empty on Pro).

contextUsageMonitor.rateLimits.colorThre.description: Warning/error percentage thresholds for statusBar.colorMode: 'rateLimit', based on the higher of the 5-hour and weekly utilization.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build -- --production && vsce package
